identificationModule.briefTitle: Immunogenicity of One Dose of Gardasil and One Dose of Gardasil-9
identificationModule.officialTitle: Persistance of Anti-HPV After a Single Dose of Gardasil and the Effect of a Dose of Gardasil-9 When Administered 3-8 Years Later

collaborators.name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study will assess the immunogenicity of one dose of Gardasil and one dose of Gardasil-9
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This is a one group exploratory study.

The main objective of this study is to assess the persistance of anti-HPV after a single dose Gardasil and the effect of one dose of Gardasil-9 when administered 3-8 years later.

interventions.name: Gardasil and Gardasil-9
interventions.description: All subjects will receive one dose of Gardasil-9. Blodd samples for serological testing will be collected just before and one month post Gardasil-9 administration.

primaryOutcomes.description: Seropositivity to 9 HPV types included in Gardasil-9 vaccine will be assessed.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Geometrical mean titers of antibodies to 9 HPV types included in Gardasil-9 vaccine will be assessed

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Have received a single dose of Gardasil 3-8 years before recruitement.

\-

Exclusion Criteria: Immunossupressed or blood coagulation problems

\-
